admission.justification: The recorded behavioral fixture assertions guard this obligation; the proof facets distinguish their limited fixture behavior from real-host or full-final acceptance.

applicability: Every resend of a held row that carries an attempted message id.
conditions: The row keeps the id it was attempted under, and the store's claim is stale and resumable.
The timeline read is bounded: the bridge refetches the last 200 entries.
exclusions: An unreadable timeline is treated as not holding the copy; the send proceeds under the same id and the host's own id record governs.
Recovery tolerates, and does not require, a host that deduplicates by itself.
statement: A stale-claim resume reuses the stored claim and resends surviving members under their original member-derived send ids. Before a resend the product reads the recipient's timeline for the attempt's id within the bounded tail it reads; when the copy is there the delivery is recorded with no send, and when the timeline cannot be read the send still goes out under the same id, so a host that records ids keeps it at most once.
